The .env.example sets NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000. Compose build args require NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL. Let's do it.

Note .env.example has DATABASE_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017 - but compose overrides with mongodb://mongo:27017.

Let me create .env.
